issues: react-native-signature-canvas depends on react-native-webview which is unsupported on Expo web preview - the signature-pad area shows 'React Native WebView does not support this platform.' Not a bug per se (signature is a native-only feature), but for web QA the signature draw+save path can only be validated on native/Expo Go. Backend PATCH /reports/{id}/signature is fully verified.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py has grown to 1027 lines. As features keep piling up (customers, digest, transcribe, signature) it should be split into routers (customers.py, digest.py, transcribe.py, reports.py, auth.py) for maintainability.

DailyReport pydantic model was missing 'signature' field - because response_model=DailyReport is applied on GET /reports/{id}, this stripped signatures out of the response even though PATCH stored them. Fixed by adding `signature: Optional[dict] = None`. Same fix now flows through GET /reports as well.
POST /api/digest/weekly runs GPT-5.4 + Resend synchronously (avg ~10-20s). Consider making the LLM call a background task and returning a job id if UI ever needs to feel snappier.

rca_of_issue: Bug found & fixed by testing agent: GET /api/reports/{id} did not return `signature` even though PATCH stored it. Root cause: get_report/list_reports use `response_model=DailyReport`, and the DailyReport pydantic model did not declare a `signature` field, so pydantic silently dropped it from the response. Fix (applied): added `signature: Optional[dict] = None` to DailyReport in /app/backend/server.py. Regression tested: 35/35 pytest passing including test_get_report_includes_signature after the fix; existing report list endpoints unaffected.
